name: Chocolate Cream or Custard No. 2
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Take one quart of milk, and when nearly boiling stir in two ounces of grated chocolate
Let it warm on the fire for a few moments, and then remove and cool
Beat the yolks of eight eggs and two whites with eight tablespoonfuls of sugar
Flavor and bake as any custard, either in cups or a large dish
Make a meringue of the remaining whites

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Take one quart of milk, and when nearly boiling stir in two ounces of grated chocolate
2. Let it warm on the fire for a few moments, and then remove and cool
3. Beat the yolks of eight eggs and two whites with eight tablespoonfuls of sugar
4. Pour the milk over them
5. Flavor and bake as any custard, either in cups or a large dish
6. Make a meringue of the remaining whites
